title: John Barrow's anti-Kardashev scale and Omega-minus civilizations

tellings.quote: if you look at the anti-artership scale uh proposed by John Barrow in the 1990s

plain: In the 1990s the cosmologist John Barrow proposed an "anti-Kardashev scale": where the familiar Kardashev scale ranks civilizations by how much energy they command, Barrow's ranks them by how small the things they can engineer are, down to what he called Omega-minus civilizations working at the tiniest scales of reality. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore brings this up without naming a source. He uses it to suggest that truly advanced beings might shrink inward rather than spread out across space.
